# Codec fixture provenance

The test literals are in the parent package's test files. They are fixed
external inputs, not generated by the codec under test.

| Source | Frame | Independently expected fields |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Identification example](https://mode-s.org/1090mhz/content/ads-b/2-identification.html), Junzi Sun | `8D4840D6202CC371C32CE0576098` | ICAO 4840D6, CA 5, TC 4, category 0, KLM1023 |
| [Position example](https://mode-s.org/1090mhz/content/ads-b/3-airborne-position.html), Junzi Sun | `8D40621D58C382D690C8AC2863A7` | ICAO 40621D, TC 11, 38000 ft, even CPR 93000/51372 |
| Same position example | `8D40621D58C386435CC412692AD6` | Same address/altitude, odd CPR 74158/50194 |
| [Velocity example A](https://mode-s.org/1090mhz/content/ads-b/5-airborne-velocity.html), Junzi Sun | `8D485020994409940838175B284F` | Subtype 1, east -8 kt, north -159 kt, vertical -832 ft/min, GNSS-minus-baro +550 ft |
| Same velocity chapter, example B | `8DA05F219B06B6AF189400CBC33F` | Subtype 3, magnetic heading 243.984375 degrees, TAS 375 kt, barometric vertical -2304 ft/min, altitude difference unavailable |

For each frame, tests compare decoding with literal expected fields and encode
those literal fields to the exact original bytes, including CRC. They do not
feed decoded fields into the encoder to establish the golden expectation.

The position example resolves to 52.2572021484375 / 3.91937255859375 when even
is newer, or 52.26578017412606 / 3.938912527901786 when odd is newer.
The local-reference example uses 52.258 / 3.918. Test timestamps are synthetic.

Additional vectors:

- Rational CPR grid cases derive from the published equations: at latitude 0,
  NL=59; at exactly 87, NL=2. Tests state exact fractions at longitude 180,
  latitude 87, the poles, and bin-rounding boundaries.
- [go-adsb v0.4.1 Gillham fixture](https://github.com/cjkreklow/go-adsb/blob/v0.4.1/adsb/message_test.go),
  `testDF4B`: `2000102a10fc86` has AC=0x102a and altitude 1300 ft.
  Removing the M bit gives ADS-B ALT=0x82a. Our test inserts that field
  into a synthetic DF17 frame; it does not claim this frame is a capture.
- Unsupported formats, unavailable values, over-range fields, and malformed
  payloads are deliberate mutations. The test helper recomputes CRC by
  polynomial division with 0x1FFF409, independently of go-adsb's parity table.
- Longitude wrap, latitude-zone crossings, and age/reference failures use
  synthetic positions and explicit times. These complement the external
  vectors and do not replace them.

Primary field reference:
[MIT Lincoln Laboratory ATC-334](https://archive.ll.mit.edu/mission/aviation/publications/publication-files/atc-reports/Grappel_2007_ATC-334_WW-15318.pdf),
Appendix A, tables A-5(1) and A-6(1). Their top magnitude codes are over-range.
In particular, final byte FF means a negative difference below -3137.5 ft.
This differs from the velocity tutorial's statement that all ones are
unavailable; tests follow the primary table.

The field tables also specify exact thresholds for entering the top code.
Tests distinguish threshold values from the next representable floating-point
input above them. Ordinary zero values remain separate from unavailable data.
